less than 10% mitochondrial transcripts pbmc3k_so <- subset(   x = pbmc3k_so,   subset =     nFeature_RNA >= 200 &     percent.mt < 10 ) # Retrieve log-normalized expression data data <- GetAssayData(   object = pbmc3k_so,   assay = "RNA",   layer = "data" )  # Approximate mitochondrial transcript percentage using # normalized expression values mt_genes <- grep(   pattern = "^MT-",   x = rownames(data),   value = TRUE )  if (length(mt_genes) > 0) {   total_expression <- Matrix::colSums(data)    pbmc3k_so$percent.mt <-      Matrix::colSums(data[mt_genes, , drop = FALSE]) /     total_expression * 100 }  #
